integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 1410.6703 lists version 1 on 2014-10-24.
integrity.hurwitz_formula_basis: The full archival text states Theorem 1.1: for singular locus of codimension at least two, Hurwitz degree is 2p+2g-2.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival source is categorized primarily as Algebraic Geometry (math.AG); the finding concerns projective associated hypersurfaces, so the assigned primary MSC family is 14.
integrity.segree_formula_basis: The Segre degree and sectional genus are independently reconstructed from the intersection ring and adjunction in RESULT.md.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the Chow and Hurwitz degrees, not the full coisotropic-degree sequence.
Only the standard Segre embedding by O(1,1) is covered.
The gcd classification is a short arithmetic consequence of the general Hurwitz-degree theorem plus the Segre intersection ring, so an unindexed source may contain the same observation.
title: Exact common divisor of Segre Chow and Hurwitz degrees
